Initial shadow generation must preserve those inputs; a later non-byte-identical cutover needs separate identity-transition admission.

questions.query: Can construction, metal, wood or glass categories automatically give a new material physical or chemical behaviour?
facts: The six dimensions are stable identity, browsing, explicit physical capabilities, native behavior/state contracts, semantic memberships and appearance.
Browse labels and visual similarity never assign physics, conduction, combustion, biological substrate, solver eligibility or interaction inheritance.
Overlapping semantic membership is explicit and gives no physical defaults in the first compiler slice.

questions.query: How should overlapping material families and presets resolve conflicting effective parameters?
facts: Use explicit field ownership and authorized overrides; reject unresolved overlaps with both source origins.
No file order, array order or mixin traversal decides precedence; finite selector intersections must be checked.
Existing transport directed-source, grain-target and liquid-owned semantics remain in their own resolver;353 adds no new active generic layers.

questions.query: Has the architecture review proved MoltenGlass cooling or yielding-liquid retry failures and approved an always-awake fix?
facts: These are source-supported hypotheses requiring source-matched reproduction; this review runs no new physics qualification.

questions.query: What does exact catalogue migration parity need beyond stable material names and pair products?
facts: Freeze every descriptor, byte ID and capability result, backend distinction, aliases and shared appearance facts against independent old-source consumers.
Preserve pair and specialized-record legacy indices because quantity accounting is positional.
Protect complete digest-bound header bytes and parser form, deterministic outputs, explicit validation errors, rollback and source-matched gates for any later runtime cutover.

questions.query: Can the Materials Lab offer viscosity and runtime reaction status controls from catalogue descriptors alone?
facts: Effective fields require the selected native consumer and applied policy; Water-CY and Mercury overrides differ from base descriptors.
Lava/Acid/Oil descriptor viscosity is not an effective generic slider; unsupported edits are disabled or source-edit-required.
Resolver-only inspection cannot invent World activity, mask or due-opportunity observations; editing requires validated owner reconstruction and preservation on refusal.
